def createparser():
    """Create the argument parser for the CLI

    :return: the parser instance
    :rtype: :class:`argparse.ArgumentParser`
    """
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=__package__,
                                     description=__doc__)
    s = parser.add_subparsers()

    # create check subcommand
    parser_check = s.add_parser("check",
                                help="Check if a version string is valid"
                                )
    parser_check.set_defaults(which="check")
    parser_check.add_argument("version",
                              help="Version to check"
                              )

    # create compare subcommand
    parser_compare = s.add_parser("compare",
                                  help="Compare two versions"
                                  )
